fact: The Star reports the e-GP system has been rolled out and covers tender advertisement, bid submission, evaluation and contract award.

Treasury Cabinet Secretary John Mbadi said in the 2026/27 Budget Statement that all procurement by government entities will go through e-GP from 1 July 2026, a platform covering the whole cycle from tender advertisement to contract management.
Treasury Cabinet Secretary John Mbadi says the e-GP system, launched on 1 July 2025, is operational across ministries, departments, agencies, county governments and state corporations.
Mbadi says there will be no exemptions in use of the e-GP system across ministries, departments, agencies, counties and state corporations.

PPRA Circular 02/2025 requires all procuring entities to register on the End-to-End Electronic Government Procurement System (e-GPS) by 30 June 2025, with procurement reports generated through it from 1 July 2025 and unregistered entities losing procuring responsibility.
Kenya's National Treasury Cabinet Secretary launched the e-GP system on 7 April 2025, with suppliers to submit bids online and manage contracts through a digital module.
The Treasury says all ministries, departments, agencies and county governments must onboard the e-GP platform from April 2025 and only procurements processed through it will be sanctioned and paid.
Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale told the Senate that an e-procurement system is being implemented at the Social Health Authority to improve transparency and competitive bidding.

K24 Digital reports the National Treasury's e-GP system, introduced in July 2025, had 402 tenders uploaded and 1,477 procuring entities listed on 21 October 2025, though no tender had been awarded through it.
K24 Digital read off the e-GP website that 402 tenders had been uploaded to the system by 21 October 2025.

Techweez reports procuring entities in Kenya continue to use the IFMIS e-Procurement module until the new end-to-end e-GP system, now piloted in twelve MDAs and counties to December 2024, is fully rolled out.
